"""User-session persistence boundary."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


class SessionStore:
    """Persists session payloads to disk as JSON, keyed by session id."""

    def __init__(self, storage_dir: str | Path = ".sessions") -> None:
        self._storage_dir = Path(storage_dir)
        self._storage_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def _path(self, session_id: str) -> Path:
        # Hash the id so it can never be used for path traversal, regardless
        # of what a caller passes in as session_id.
        digest = hashlib.sha256(session_id.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        return self._storage_dir / f"{digest}.json"

    def save(self, session_id: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        tmp_path = self._path(session_id).with_suffix(".tmp")
        tmp_path.write_text(json.dumps(payload), encoding="utf-8")
        tmp_path.replace(self._path(session_id))

    def load(self, session_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        path = self._path(session_id)
        if not path.exists():
            return None
        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
